title: Natural group law on an algebraic space
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $G$ an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. A group law on $G$ is a group structure on $G(T)$ for every $S$-scheme $T$, with restriction maps preserving multiplication and the identity. These natural operations give multiplication, inverse and identity of a group algebraic space by Yoneda. No commutativity, smoothness or finiteness assumption is made. Write $1_T$ and $x y$ for the identity and product in this specified group structure.
